body: Promise-credibility forward test, Nov-2026 cohort (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Jash Engineering (JASH). Probability 0.52 (naive sector base rate 0.56) that: Jash Engineering (JASH) FY27 consolidated net profit >= Rs 100 cr. Probabilities set only by the pre-registered rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/forward_test_2026-11/prereg.md s4): p0 = 0.562 (sector peers (Capital Goods), group 'other', n=16); SAC -0.188 x w 0.200 (N=5) -> P_cred = 0.52. Evidence: call of 2026-08-12: "we are expecting Rs.100 crore plus profit this year" (Q1FY27). Resolution: YES if FY27 consolidated profit for the period >= Rs 100 cr (floor, strict). Source: Q4FY27 results, press release / investor presentation and Q4FY27 earnings call transcript (NSE). Resolve by 2027-06-15; score Brier of P_cred vs P_base (prereg s5).

data.adjustment_applied: p0 = 0.562 (sector peers (Capital Goods), group 'other', n=16); SAC -0.188 x w 0.200 (N=5) -> P_cred = 0.52
data.adjustment_rule: P_cred = clip(p0 + N/(N+20) x SAC, 0.05, 0.95); SAC = mean(y - p0(group)) over the company's resolved past promises (strict: delivered=1, else 0); N<3 -> P_cred = p0. P_base = p0.
data.base_rate_reasoning: Naive forecaster = leave-one-out strict delivery rate of Capital Goods peers in group 'other' (sector peers (Capital Goods), group 'other', n=16). No company-specific information.
data.promise_quote: "we are expecting Rs.100 crore plus profit this year" (Q1FY27)
data.resolution_rule: YES if FY27 consolidated profit for the period >= Rs 100 cr (floor, strict).
data.resolution_source: Q4FY27 results, press release / investor presentation and Q4FY27 earnings call transcript (NSE)

title: Paper call: Jash Engineering (JASH) FY27 consolidated net profit >= Rs 100 cr
